info.name: Kompare - Provider Reviews
info.description: All operations in the Provider Reviews Swagger group, plus a simple login. Import the companion environment and select it. Set email/password to an existing verified account, then send Login: it saves access_token automatically. Protected requests use that bearer token. Moderation requires a current super_admin or support_admin account; use the same Login request with that account before admin actions. All sample IDs and accounts are fictional. Create requests save returned IDs. Examples describe current implementation, not live recorded responses. Public creation accepts anonymous reviews/comments; separate no-auth variants are included. Send individually; do not run destructive examples against real content unintentionally.
